name: GitHub MCP Server
use_when: the agent needs to read and act on GitHub issues, pull requests, code and Actions
install: remote https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ or local Docker image with GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN

name: Playwright MCP
use_when: the agent needs to open, click through and check a real browser page through the accessibility tree

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
use_when: you want the agent to read console, network and performance traces from Chrome while debugging

name: shadcn MCP server
use_when: you want the agent to browse, search and install components from shadcn and other registries set in components.json

name: Supabase MCP Server
use_when: the agent needs to manage tables, read config and query data in a Supabase project
note: older links point to supabase-community/supabase-mcp

name: Sentry MCP
use_when: the agent should read production errors and issues from Sentry while fixing bugs
note: npm package metadata points to getsentry/toolkit; GitHub page is getsentry/sentry-mcp

name: Next.js DevTools MCP
use_when: you build with Next.js and want the agent to read the dev server's errors and Next.js docs

name: awesome-mcp-servers (punkpeye)
note: web directory at https://glama.ai/mcp/servers

name: Figma MCP server
license: Figma Developer Terms (not open source); free Starter use limited to 6 tool calls a month
install: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp
note: Full use needs a Dev or Full seat on a paid plan. Free option: export design tokens and screenshots by hand.

name: Agent Skills specification
use_when: you write a SKILL.md and need the exact format rules, best practices and the list of clients that load skills

name: skills-ref
use_when: you want to check a skill folder against the spec before publishing it
install: from the skills-ref/ folder of agentskills/agentskills
note: an npm package named skills-ref (MIT) exists but its metadata has no repository link; not confirmed to be the same tool

name: Context7
license: MIT (MCP server); the API backend and crawler are closed
use_when: the agent needs current, version-specific docs and code examples for a library instead of its training data
install: npx ctx7 setup, or remote https://mcp.context7.com/mcp (API key recommended for higher limits)

name: Blender MCP
use_when: you want an agent to drive a running Blender over MCP to build or edit scenes
install: claude mcp add blender uvx mcp-for-blender, then uvx mcp-for-blender install-addon
note: PyPI package is mcp-for-blender; needs Blender installed and the add-on enabled

name: Blockbench
use_when: you want low-poly or blocky models with pixel-art textures, quick to learn
install: download, or use the web app

name: FreeCAD
use_when: you need precise parametric CAD parts rather than artistic models

name: SVGO
use_when: you want to shrink and clean SVG files from the command line or a build step

name: Krita
use_when: you need to paint illustrations, textures or concept art with a tablet
note: GitHub repo is a mirror of invent.kde.org/graphics/krita

name: Pixelorama
use_when: you want a free open-source pixel art and sprite animation editor

name: Aseprite
license: paid; source available under the Aseprite EULA (some modules MIT)
note: Free option: Pixelorama.

name: rembg
use_when: you need to remove image backgrounds locally from a script or CLI

name: Squoosh
use_when: you want to compress and convert images (WebP, AVIF) and compare quality side by side
install: web app; the npm CLI @squoosh/cli exists but its status was not checked

name: Penpot
use_when: you want an open-source Figma-style design and prototyping tool you can self-host
install: web app, or self-host with Docker (https://penpot.app/self-host)

name: Excalidraw
use_when: you want quick hand-drawn style diagrams and wireframes
install: web app, or npm i @excalidraw/excalidraw to embed

name: tldraw
license: custom tldraw license (npm says SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md)
use_when: you want to embed a whiteboard canvas in your own app
note: reported to need a license key in production; license file not read

name: Figma
license: free plan for individuals (3 projects, 2 members, 30-day version history); paid plans beyond that
note: Free option: Penpot.

name: Burst
license: Burst license, mostly "Shopify some rights reserved" (some photos CC0)
use_when: you need product, e-commerce and small-business photos
note: Check each photo's license; CC0 photos are listed at https://burst.shopify.com/licenses/creative-commons

name: StockSnap
use_when: you want photos that are CC0 so they can sit in a repo without license questions

name: Openverse
license: per item (CC licenses and public domain); the code is MIT
use_when: you want one search (and API) across many openly licensed image and audio sources, filterable by license
install: openverse.org search, or its public API
note: Each result keeps its own CC license; read it and credit where required. Catalog docs https://make.wordpress.org/openverse/handbook/openverse-catalog/

name: Wikimedia Commons
license: per file (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and others)
use_when: you need a photo or diagram of a real place, thing or historic subject
note: Read each file's license; CC BY-SA needs credit and share-alike. Not all files are free of trademark or personality rights.

name: NASA Image and Video Library
license: generally not copyrighted (US government work); see NASA media guidelines
use_when: you need space, Earth and spaceflight images, video or audio
note: NASA logos and insignia are restricted (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/nasa-logo-use/); don't imply NASA endorsement; some items are third-party.

name: Library of Congress Free to Use and Reuse
license: public domain or no known restrictions (per set)
use_when: you want themed sets of historic American photos, posters and maps that are cleared for reuse
note: Machine-readable sets at https://data.labs.loc.gov/free-to-use/

name: Rijksmuseum
license: public domain images (CC0) for most collection items; see data policy
use_when: you want Dutch Golden Age paintings and prints in high resolution
install: download from the collection, or the data services

name: The Public Domain Review
license: curated public-domain works; rights label on each item
note: A curated guide that links to the source archives; see https://publicdomainreview.org/reusing-material/

name: Open Peeps
use_when: you want hand-drawn people you can mix and match and keep in a repo

name: Humaaans
use_when: you want flat, colourful people illustrations you can recombine

name: Open Doodles
use_when: you want loose, sketchy people illustrations with no credit needed

name: unDraw
use_when: you want flat scene illustrations recolourable to your brand colour

name: Blush
use_when: you want customizable illustrations from many artists in one editor

name: Storyset
use_when: you want editable, animatable scene illustrations and can show a credit

name: DrawKit
use_when: you want polished illustration packs for landing pages and apps

name: IRA Design

name: Kenney

name: Poly Haven

name: ShareTextures
use_when: you want more CC0 PBR textures, especially architectural surfaces

name: PlayCanvas Engine

name: three-mesh-bvh
